title: 242 BROOME STREET
summary: A private commission within Essex Crossing, offering commanding views of the New York skyline.
description: At 242 Broome Street, MOCA developed kitchens, bathrooms, and common areas that translate the building’s contemporary architecture into refined, functional, and cohesive interiors.

image.alt: Angular facade with a geometric window grid against a blue sky.

hero.alt: The facade of 242 Broome Street in New York, viewed from below against a blue sky.

sections.title: Kitchens
sections.body: MOCA developed sophisticated kitchens combining custom walnut cabinetry, integrated functionality, and refined materials to create elegant spaces designed for contemporary urban living.

image.alt: A kitchen at 242 Broome Street with full-height cabinetry, a central island, and pendant lighting.

sections.title: Bathrooms
sections.body: The bathrooms feature tailored vanities, thoughtful storage, and carefully selected finishes, creating serene and functional environments with a distinctly sophisticated residential character.

image.alt: A bathroom at 242 Broome Street with a freestanding bathtub, double vanity, and views across New York.

sections.title: Common amenities
sections.body: The property offers a 24-hour doorman, a fitness center, an entertainment lounge with a kitchen and billiards, and a landscaped rooftop terrace for outdoor dining.

image.alt: The landscaped rooftop terrace at 242 Broome Street, with outdoor seating and views of the Manhattan skyline at dusk.

materials.label: METALS
materials.description: Metal finishes bring precise detailing, subtle sheen, and enduring character, creating elegant accents that complement cabinetry, fixtures, and shared interiors.

image.alt: A close view of the selected metal finish.

materials.label: LACQUERS
materials.description: Lacquer finishes bring smooth surfaces, balanced color, and refined definition, creating tailored cabinetry that unifies kitchens, bathrooms, and shared interiors.

image.alt: A close view of the surface selected to represent lacquer finishes.

materials.label: WOOD
materials.description: Natural wood brings inviting warmth, expressive grain, and lasting character, creating bespoke cabinetry that enriches kitchens, bathrooms, and shared interiors.

image.alt: A close view of the selected wood grain.

materials.label: MARBLE
materials.description: Natural marble brings timeless elegance, distinctive veining, and refined durability, creating sophisticated surfaces that enrich kitchens, bathrooms, and shared interiors.

image.alt: A close view of the selected dark marble surface and its natural variation.
